questions.enonce_markdown:
A research department of a teaching hospital needs to share the results of its research with other interested bodies and individuals. The research is currently published and discussed via the internet.

The National Association of Teaching Hospitals (NATH) is considering the use of private intranet for such research communications. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using an intranet in this example. (6 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
An **intranet** is a private network that uses internet technology (web pages, e-mail, browsers) but is reachable only by authorised members of the organisation.

**Advantages for NATH (3 marks)**

- **Security and confidentiality:** research results and any patient-related data are placed behind a firewall and password control, so only authorised members can read or change them; the risk of hacking, malware and leaks is much smaller than on the open internet.
- **Control of content:** NATH decides who may publish, who may read, and which version is current, so the information is consistent and reliable (no unverified comments from the public).
- **Speed and cost:** traffic stays on the internal network, so pages load fast and use no (or little) paid internet bandwidth; the web tools are standard and cheap to reuse, and discussion between the member hospitals can take place on the intranet.

**Disadvantages (3 marks)**

- **Limited audience:** the other interested bodies and individuals who are outside NATH cannot see the research unless they are given accounts or an extranet or VPN is set up, so the results are less widely disseminated than on the internet.
- **Cost and maintenance:** servers, network equipment and skilled staff are needed to set up, secure and maintain the intranet, and the content must be updated by NATH itself.
- **Security still has to be managed:** if the intranet is connected to the internet (for remote access) a firewall, user accounts and regular updates are needed, and an insider or a stolen password can still compromise the data.

questions.enonce_markdown:
LANs are used in the data communication network of a company. Explain the purpose of each of the following as used in the NATH computer network:

(a) Routers. (2 marks)

(b) Bridges. (2 marks)

(c) Modems. (2 marks)
questions.corrige_markdown:
**(a) Router (2 marks).** A router **connects different networks** (for example the hospital LAN to another LAN or to the internet). It reads the destination IP address of each packet, uses its routing table to choose the best path and **forwards the packet** towards its destination.

**(b) Bridge (2 marks).** A bridge **joins two LANs or two segments of the same LAN** that use the same protocol so that they work as one network. It reads the MAC address of each frame and passes across only the frames meant for the other segment, which **reduces traffic and collisions**.

**(c) Modem (2 marks).** A modem (**mod**ulator-**dem**odulator) converts the **digital signals** of a computer into the **analogue signals** that a telephone or cable line can carry (modulation) and converts the incoming analogue signals back into digital ones (demodulation). It connects the NATH network to a service provider and so to the internet or remote sites.
